sloka: नरान्तकं हतं दृष्ट्वा चुक्रुशुर्नैर्ऋतर्षभाः।देवान्तकस्त्रिमूर्धा च पौलस्त्यश्च महोदरः ।। ६.७०.१ ।।
transliteration: narāntakaṁ hataṁ dṛṣṭvā cukruśurnairṛtarṣabhāḥ।devāntakastrimūrdhā ca paulastyaśca mahodaraḥ ।। 6.70.1 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the bulls among Rakshasas Naranthaka, Devanthaka, Trisira and Mahodara a scion of Paulastya and Mahodara, killed the Rakshasas cried aloud.
